# Parley v0.1.70

This unnotarized test beta fixes a hang: Parley could freeze for good when a
pane was restarted, closed or quit after the Mac had slept, because Ghostty's
renderer thread was stuck inside CoreVideo. Nothing changes in saved data or
the agent protocol (still 34).

## The hang

A macOS hang report from v0.1.65 on 14 October 2026 showed the main thread in
`ghostty_surface_free` waiting on the pane's renderer thread, which had been
stuck in `CVDisplayLinkStop` since shortly before the Mac woke from sleep.
That is upstream Ghostty issue #14150: the render thread started and stopped
its CVDisplayLink itself, CoreVideo does the same on the main thread when a
display sleeps or wakes, and a start landing inside a stop left the stop
waiting forever. The earlier fix Parley required (upstream `72cf508`) removed
one deadlock on that path but not this one.

Upstream Ghostty fixed it on 13 October 2026 in commit `ffaaf5d7`, "renderer:
only start and stop the CVDisplayLink on the main thread" (PR #14691). No
libghostty-spm release carries it yet, so this build takes it through the
markjoyeuxcom fork: the fork now builds the GhosttyKit XCFramework itself for
one upstream wrapper tag, from the wrapper's own Ghostty commit (`1e9e14af`)
and patch stack plus that fix as a patch, macOS slices only, and republishes
the wrapper tag as `2.2.2026101301-clt.displaylink`. Parley pins that tag.
When a wrapper release carries the fix, Parley goes back to pinning upstream.

The pin floor in the engineering guide now names both commits.

## Also in this build

Upstream libghostty-spm closed issue #81 on 13 October: since wrapper
2.2.2026101301 its string catalog ships precompiled, so the package builds
with the Command Line Tools on its own and the fork's catalog patch is a
no-op. The Command Line Tools remain enough to build Parley.

## Going back to v0.1.69

Nothing in saved data changes. v0.1.69 has the hang.

## Validation and known limits

The release workflow repeats the following before publishing this beta:
- the deterministic checks and the repository scans;
- the app build and the 25-round Ghostty soak;
- packaging, checksums and packaged-launch verification.

Checked before the pull request merged: 623 native checks, 82 script tests,
both scans, the build and the 25-round soak in a Command Line Tools Tart VM
against the patched Ghostty, including the check that reads Ghostty's process
exit record, which is re-checked whenever the Ghostty pin changes; and the
checks on GitHub's Xcode 26.6 runner. The hang itself needs a sleep and wake
to reproduce, so the fix is verified by the upstream change and its author's
analysis of CoreVideo, not by a check here. The hand tests from v0.1.69 (new
Settings forms and the backup round trip) are still waiting.

Agy's loading of Parley's instructions from its added folder is still
unverified, fresh or resumed.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the
stable Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation
instructions.
